sentences.text: The heart is a muscular organ in humans and other animals , which pumps blood through the blood vessels of the circulatory system .	muscular	muscle	organ	Organ (anatomy)	blood	blood	circulatory system	circulatory system
Blood provides the body with oxygen and nutrients , as well as assists in the removal of metabolic wastes .	oxygen	oxygen
In humans , the heart is located between the lungs , in the middle compartment of the chest .	middle compartment	mediastinum	chest	thorax	lungs	lungs
In humans , other mammals , and birds , the heart is divided into four chambers : upper left and right atria ; and lower left and right ventricles .	atria	Atrium (heart)	ventricles	Ventricle (heart)
Commonly the right atrium and ventricle are referred together as the right heart and their left counterparts as the left heart .
Fish , in contrast , have two chambers , an atrium and a ventricle , while reptiles have three chambers .
In a healthy heart blood flows one way through the heart due to heart valves , which prevent backflow .	blood	blood	backflow	cardiac regurgitation
The heart is enclosed in a protective sac , the pericardium , which also contains a small amount of fluid .	pericardium	pericardium	fluid	pericardial fluid
The wall of the heart is made up of three layers : epicardium , myocardium , and endocardium .	epicardium	epicardium	myocardium	myocardium	endocardium	endocardium
The heart pumps blood with a rhythm determined by a group of pacemaking cells in the sinoatrial node .	blood	blood	sinoatrial node	sinoatrial node

These generate a current that causes contraction of the heart , traveling through the atrioventricular node and along the conduction system of the heart .	atrioventricular node	atrioventricular node	conduction system of the heart	conduction system of the heart

The heart receives blood low in oxygen from the systemic circulation , which enters the right atrium from the superior and inferior venae cavae and passes to the right ventricle .	blood	blood	oxygen	oxygen	systemic circulation	systemic circulation	superior	superior vena cava	inferior	inferior vena cava	venae cavae	venae cavae

From here it is pumped into the pulmonary circulation , through the lungs where it receives oxygen and gives off carbon dioxide .	oxygen	oxygen	pulmonary circulation	pulmonary circulation	lungs	lungs	carbon dioxide	carbon dioxide

Oxygenated blood then returns to the left atrium , passes through the left ventricle and is pumped out through the aorta to the systemic circulation − where the oxygen is used and metabolized to carbon dioxide .	blood	blood	oxygen	oxygen	systemic circulation	systemic circulation	aorta	aorta	metabolized	metabolized	carbon dioxide	carbon dioxide
The heart beats at a resting rate close to 72 beats per minute .	rate	heart rate

Exercise temporarily increases the rate , but lowers resting heart rate in the long term , and is good for heart health .	rate	heart rate	Exercise	Physical exercise	resting heart rate	resting heart rate
Cardiovascular diseases -LRB- CVD -RRB- are the most common cause of death globally as of 2008 , accounting for 30 % of deaths .
Of these more than three quarters are a result of coronary artery disease and stroke .	coronary artery disease	coronary artery disease	stroke	stroke

Risk factors include : smoking , being overweight , little exercise , high cholesterol , high blood pressure , and poorly controlled diabetes , among others .	blood	blood	smoking	smoking	overweight	overweight	high cholesterol	high cholesterol	high blood pressure	hypertension	diabetes	diabetes mellitus
Cardiovascular diseases frequently have no symptoms or may cause chest pain or shortness of breath .	chest	thorax	chest pain	chest pain	shortness of breath	shortness of breath

Diagnosis of heart disease is often done by the taking of a medical history , listening to the heart-sounds with a stethoscope , ECG , and ultrasound .	stethoscope	stethoscope	medical history	medical history	listening	auscultation	ECG	electrocardiogram	ultrasound	ultrasound
Specialists who focus on diseases of the heart are called cardiologists , although many specialties of medicine may be involved in treatment .	cardiologists	cardiologists
